analyst.summary: Aditya Birla Capital is a fast-scaling, now-unified financial-services conglomerate (NBFC/HFC lending, life and health insurance, AMC) with a clean recent regulatory slate (merger completed, CEO term RBI-approved, NBFC-ICC conversion done) and improving loan-book asset quality, but FY26 profit growth was flattered by a lower effective tax rate even as operating margins and ROE compressed through the year - at ~29x earnings and ~3x book, the stock is priced for flawless execution on a margin-recovery story that has not yet shown up in the numbers.
